notes.subject: ואזרעם
notes.rationale: זרע pun on 'sow seed' — Israel scattered as seed among nations; picture partly lost.

notes.subject: וחיו את בניהם
notes.rationale: 'live with their children' vs some read 'keep alive / sustain their children'.

translation: Na bai mi planim ⟨את⟩ ol man long olgeta lain bilong ol manmeri, na long ol ples klia i stap haulong, ol bai tingim mi; na ol bai laiv wantaim ⟨את⟩ ol pikinini bilong ol, na ol bai kam bek.
